Q435.reason: The brother’s affidavit is hearsay without an established exception, whereas portrait inscriptions qualify under [Rule 803(13)](https://www.law.cornell.edu/rules/fre/rule_803).

Q422.reason: Conspiracy requires intent to commit the assault but not knowledge of jurisdictional facts under [United States v. Feola](https://supreme.justia.com/cases/federal/us/420/671/).

Q921.reason: Entry by threats establishes burglary, the forced taking establishes robbery, and the foreseeable heart attack supports [felony murder](https://www.law.cornell.edu/wex/felony_murder_rule).
